title: Listing policy v2 core aggregate cutover
summary: Under listing policy v2, tokenized fund shares leave the core stablecoin aggregate on a dated cutover (core-stablecoins-v2). Published PSI history is not restated; pre-cutover replays keep the frozen core-stablecoins-v1 membership while days from the cutover onward use v2 membership.
impact: Core aggregate identity advances from `core-stablecoins-v1` to `core-stablecoins-v2` on `CORE_STABLECOIN_AGGREGATE_V2_CUTOVER_DATE` (`2026-11-25`, 00:00 UTC). Live PSI samples and post-cutover replays stamp `aggregateUniverse: "core-stablecoins-v2"`; cross-boundary digest and weekly-recap comparisons fence against mixing v1 and v2 universes.

Pre-cutover published daily rows remain exactly as published without restatement. Historical PSI replays strictly before the cutover resolve membership from the frozen `core-stablecoins-v1` member snapshot (`shared/data/stablecoins/core-aggregate-v1-members.json`) and stamp `core-stablecoins-v1`; replays from the cutover onward use active v2 membership.

Formula weights, component caps, depreciation schedule, reference-market rules, and condition bands are unchanged. Activation is 2026-11-25 00:00 UTC (1795564800); re-date effectiveAt if deploy slips.

title: Admitted event coverage and dated index inputs
summary: Public FX evidence ships off by default. On a clocked publication PSI uses the event's admitted quote and reference, preserving a prior admitted contribution during a hold when comparable event history exists. DEWS stress breadth excludes only coins with a depeg contribution at the sample time.
impact: Historical calculation uses date-effective core membership, exact seven-day pairs with no explicitly partial endpoint, and admitted event intervals. Severe legacy closure openings can use dated benchmark evidence. A dated market quote remains available when its native quantity is unavailable.

Compatibility scoring accepts fresh legacy native quotes while the reference market is open or the measured deviation reaches the severe closure threshold. Independent-market credit requires traded-pair lineage. Scheduled sampling excludes reviewed events and events with explicit coverage that omits the sample.

Reviewed event repairs change only affected contributions and their rolling averages. Live weekly trend compares USD caps seven UTC dates apart. Older publications retain their prior-week USD buckets. Token-count movement is recorded separately.

title: Historical replay applies the reference-market closure rule
summary: Replayed and repaired PSI history no longer counts gold, silver and FX depeg events that the v3.68 closed-market hold would never have opened, and a one-time repair removes those events' effect from published daily rows.
impact: Every historical replay (the PSI backfill, audit repairs and the repair job) applies `replayReferenceMarketEventStart` (`shared/lib/reference-market-hours.ts`): an event on a gold, silver or FX peg that began while its reference market was closed and peaked below 2,500 bps is dropped if it ended within six hours of the reopen, and otherwise counts from the reopen while keeping its stored start for scoring. History keeps no closed-session deviation, so the stored peak decides severity. Replay rows record `referenceMarketRule: true`.

The one-time `repair-reference-market-artifacts` job changes each affected published day by only those events' effect: a replay-built row by the difference between replays with and without them, a live daily average by the mean per-sample difference over its complete set of 30-minute samples. On production data it raises 124 daily rows, 45 by a point or more, up to 16.4 points on 14 March 2020 (PAXG and XAUT) and 9.0 on 9 August 2020 (XAUT); 13-15 November 2026 follows once its daily rows exist. 21 days stay as published: 20 live days from June to August 2026 whose samples have expired, and 2 March 2026, which has no DEWS archive. Every evaluated row records `referenceMarketRepair`.
Live scoring, formula weights, caps and bands are unchanged.

title: Current non-USD references and closed-market holds
summary: Live PSI scores open non-USD events against the current authoritative reference, as detection does, instead of the reference stored when the event opened, and holds FX and gold/silver contributions at their pre-closure values while their reference market is shut.
impact: A USD-domain event on a non-USD peg (gold, silver or fiat FX) measures its current USD price against the current authoritative reference derived from the published stablecoins payload; without one the event is unpriced (`open-depeg-no-price`) rather than scored against its stored open-time reference. USD-peg and native-domain events are unchanged. On 15 November 2026 the open XAUm event, opened on 22 October with a $4,051.22 gold reference, scored -4.30% against that stored reference while trading 0.49% above the current gold reference; XAGm still carried a $65.27 September silver reference against $48.65 spot.

While its reference market is closed (`shared/lib/reference-market-hours.ts`), a non-USD fiat or GOLD/SILVER coin whose live deviation is below the 2,500 bps severe band (raw bps; an unpriced reading counts as held) keeps the deviation it had in the last sample published before the closure, within the six-hour replay-price budget, while detection has trusted none of its events since the closure began; a promotion or trusted severe reading inside the closure keeps it live. A held coin missing from that sample, or an unreadable sample, is unpriced (`open-depeg-no-price`), never zero. Samples written during a closure record `referenceMarketClosedSince`, `referenceMarketBaselineAt` and `heldContributorIds`.
Historical replay is unchanged and still scores stored references. Formula weights, caps and bands are unchanged.

title: Canonical historical repair and unavailable-input retention
summary: PSI v3.67 can change repaired historical scores by using one canonical replay path, paired supply identities and the post-audit eligible event universe. Missing required trend or DEWS history preserves accepted days rather than fabricating flat growth or zero stress; formula weights and condition bands are unchanged.
impact: Audit-triggered repairs and bounded backfills share daily prices, native-domain evidence, DEWS archives and persisted input provenance. Event exclusion or restoration recomputes PSI from the post-audit eligible universe in the same atomic transaction.

Historical seven-day trend compares only paired admitted supply identities, independently of the current market-cap denominator. Observed zero remains valid, but an unavailable or unusable prior denominator holds the accepted day instead of inventing flat growth.

Missing required v3 DEWS archives remain unavailable and preserve accepted days; an observed all-CALM archive still contributes measured zero stress. Archive date and row count remain part of replay provenance.

Every historical entrypoint loads the same full twenty-one-day supply lookback, combining the seven-day trend interval and fourteen-day as-of margin, so narrow replay windows do not truncate the eligible cohort.

Contributor attribution preserves the full-precision scoring factor without rewriting legacy factors. Displayed thirty-day extrema and averages use source-anchored UTC calendar coverage rather than row count; neither changes the scoring formula.

Historical repairs are score-moving. Fixed-clock replay, attribution of changed days and owner review are release prerequisites; this entry does not claim a completed replay or rewrite of stored history.
Activation is provisionally 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (1791676800); re-date effectiveAt at release

title: Observed supply admission and explicit partial-input quality
summary: Live PSI excludes unavailable current supply from market-cap denominators and contributors, pairs only usable historical supply, and reports successful partial publication as ok with input-quality findings.
impact: Absent, empty, wholly invalid, nonfinite or negative current totals are omitted; explicit observed zero remains admissible
Unavailable previous-week totals are omitted from both trend sides; a nonpositive or nonfinite paired denominator holds the prior sample with trend-inputs-unavailable instead of inventing zero trend
Stored snapshots and the API disclose supplyUnavailableIds and trendUnavailableIds alongside existing unpriced-open-event diagnostics
A successful sample and prune returns psi-sample-published with ok plus quality for omissions; failed dependencies still hold publication
Six-hour USD/native price-evidence and 3600-second accepted-DEWS budgets, pure formula and historical rows are unchanged

title: Persisted current native-peg event quotes
summary: Live PSI reads directly observed native quotes retained by the existing depeg producer, without adding network requests to the DB-only lane.
impact: Each active native event retains its latest validated CoinGecko value, upstream observation clock, and source in D1 cache
Live sampling selects the latest native observation at or before evaluation, strictly younger than six hours; absent or stale evidence still discloses open-depeg-no-price
USD prices and FX cannot synthesize native deviation; producer fetch count and historical replay inputs are unchanged

title: Null daily components without fabricated zero
summary: Daily PSI snapshots persist missing components as null while retaining all-day score averages and per-component observation counts.
impact: An all-null component remains null; an observed zero remains numeric zero
Partially observed components average only their observations and disclose their sample count
All-day averaging and mixed-version provenance are unchanged; historical rows are not rewritten
Live open-depeg inputs reject nominal par and legacy protocol-redeem cache rows on protocol-par routes as observed prices; absent replay-safe evidence is disclosed as open-depeg-no-price

title: Quote-domain-safe event inputs and daily provenance
summary: Live and historical PSI preserve native event quote domains; daily all-sample averages disclose methodology and component sample counts.
impact: Native events use timestamped native start or recovery evidence retained in D1, strictly as-of and younger than six hours; USD prices and changing FX cannot manufacture native deviation
No continuous native quote history is retained: unprovable windows disclose open-depeg-no-price instead of borrowing an untimed event peak or rewriting native references
Daily scores still average every sample across version transitions, with explicit mixed-version breakdown and per-component sample counts
Release A readers accept null daily components; the numeric snapshot writer remains unchanged until the separately gated nullable-producer activation

title: As-of historical supply lookup
summary: The historical replay now reads the most recent supply snapshot at or before the day being rebuilt instead of the nearest snapshot in either direction.
impact: A replayed UTC day can no longer take market cap or historical price from a supply snapshot observed after that day
A day with no snapshot within 14 days before it leaves the coin out of that day's universe instead of borrowing a later observation
Live 30-minute sampling and daily aggregation are unchanged

title: Paired 7-day trend inputs
summary: PSI now excludes assets without observed previous-week supply from both sides of the 7-day market-cap trend ratio instead of treating them as zero.
impact: The live 7-day trend term pairs current and previous-week market caps only for assets with observed previous-week supply
Assets without observed previous-week supply no longer contribute zero to the denominator while contributing current market cap to the numerator
Published current market-cap totals and the historical replay path are unchanged

title: Core-market aggregate universe
summary: PSI now measures the core stablecoin market without counting parent-linked variants or investment products as independent monetary supply.
impact: The live and historical PSI universes include active core stablecoins, active cash equivalents, and PSI-only shadow assets
Tracked variants remain readable on their detail and browse surfaces but no longer contribute market cap, trend, depeg severity, breadth, or DEWS stress breadth to PSI
Stable-value investment products remain tracked for research while staying outside the ecosystem monetary aggregate

title: Exact DEWS generation dependency
summary: PSI now reads the exact DEWS generation advertised by the published-generation pointer instead of selecting latest rows at or before that timestamp.
impact: Retained stale DEWS rows for assets absent from the current published generation no longer fail PSI freshness
Stress breadth is computed from a single coherent DEWS generation rather than a mix of current rows and older retained latest rows
The no-pointer fallback remains bounded by the recent scan window and the existing staleness gate

title: Fail-closed DEWS freshness dependency
summary: PSI now requires a non-empty, fresh latest DEWS row set before publishing a new sample, preventing stale or wiped stress signals from being treated as zero stress breadth.
impact: The 30-minute cron skips PSI sample publication when latest DEWS rows are absent, missing computed_at, or older than two compute-dews intervals
DEWS stress breadth is now computed from warning-band rows only after dependency freshness is proven across the latest DEWS row set
Public PSI remains anchored to the last valid stored sample instead of publishing a healthier fresh score from stale or absent early-warning inputs

title: Active-only PSI universe
summary: PSI eligibility now resolves to active tracked stablecoins plus PSI-only shadow assets, excluding pre-launch and frozen tracked rows from live PSI denominators and repair scopes.
impact: Pre-launch tracked assets no longer enter the PSI-eligible registry before launch
Frozen tracked archives remain available on readable public detail surfaces but are excluded from live PSI computation
PSI-only shadow assets remain included for historical continuity and admin replay repairs

title: Fail-closed depeg input availability
summary: PSI no longer publishes a fresh sample when the active-depeg input query is unavailable, preventing false continuity from an incomplete core dependency.
impact: The 30-minute cron now returns degraded and skips the sample when `depeg_events` cannot be queried
Only already-open depegs missing a current stablecoins price may use the replay-safe `price_cache` fallback; table-level depeg input loss is no longer treated as an empty event set
Public PSI remains anchored to the last valid stored sample instead of silently publishing from partial core inputs

title: Open-depeg replay-price fallback
summary: Active depegs now stay in PSI when the current stablecoins snapshot temporarily loses a usable price but a recent replay-safe price-cache entry still exists.
impact: Severity and breadth now fall back to the last replay-safe positive `price_cache` value for already-open depegs when the current stablecoins snapshot price is missing
Replay fallback is capped to recent cache entries (6-hour TTL) rather than unbounded historical prices
Prevents transient contributor/sample omissions during price-validation churn without changing the PSI formula, caps, or bands

title: DEWS stress breadth component
summary: Added DEWS-derived stress breadth as an explicit PSI component to capture broad non-depeg stress.
impact: Formula changed to: 100 - severity - breadth - stressBreadth + trend
New stressBreadth cap of 5 points
Cron now reads latest DEWS bands (ALERT/WARNING/DANGER) to derive stress breadth
